basic_info.description: Spacious and updated Noe Valley condo situated in a prime location with quick access to Noe's 24th Street, the Mission District, public transportation, and freeway access. This full floor flat offers comfortable living with a remodeled kitchen with brand new finishes and ample storage, opening to a formal dining room. Adjacent is a generously sized living room with an original fireplace, large windows, and detailed moulding (noticed throughout the unit). Down the hall are two bright bedrooms with walk-in closets and green outlooks, a remodeled full bath with separate tub and shower, and a half bath. In addition, the hallway is equipped with two storage closets, and access to a sunny, center patio. A shared garage provides a parking spot, deeded storage, deeded laundry, and access to a landscaped west facing garden.
